# Subagent Brief Template

Use when delegating focused work to ClawDev or another worker.

## Task
- slice name:
- repo/path:
- goal:

## Scope
- in scope:
- out of scope:

## Required outputs
- code/files expected:
- tests/builds to run:
- commit required: yes/no

## Reporting requirements
Provide back:
- stage reached
- files touched
- tests/builds run and results
- commit hash
- blockers/follow-ups
- current step / ETA / blockers in periodic updates if task runs long

## Constraints
- keep the slice coherent and minimal
- prefer existing patterns in the codebase
- do not widen scope without reason
- if blocked, say the narrowest real blocker

## Completion test
The slice is only done when:
- requested code exists
- relevant validation has run
- evidence is reportable clearly
